text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that Toronto and East York Community Council rescind appointments to the Community Centre 55 Board of Management made on July 8, 2025 in Item TE24.74. The Community Centre 55 Board of Management had submitted a letter to Toronto and East York Community Council (June 20, 2025) requesting the appointments however, the letter was submitted in error as the Board of Management already had its full complement of members.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the appointments of Natalie Johnson and Pauline Grant to the Community Centre 55 Board of Management, made in TE24.74.
